__baseline_prompt__.text: An espionage photograph of a woman guided by the supplied reference face and short dark bob, preserving the reference facial proportions, dark eyes, soft facial contours and wispy fringe. In this invented espionage moment, she is working as an exhibition liaison during a museum conservation-preview reception. Her ivory tailored waistcoat, black trousers and small staff badge belong naturally among the formally dressed visitors. Her restrained warmth and elegant upright bearing give her a quiet personal magnetism. The event takes place beside a recently restored large portrait, with a rope marking the threshold into a brighter conservation room and a uniformed attendant watching the public doorway. At the shutter she is completing a concealed paper transfer while appearing to explain an exhibition catalogue to a male guest. Her left hand holds the open catalogue level at her waist, its broad pages forming a shallow horizontal roof over their lower hands. In the clearly visible gap beneath the catalogue, her right thumb and index finger hold the upper edge of one folded cream card while the guest's left thumb and index finger take its lower edge. The same single card bridges both grips; the hands approach from opposite sides with clear separate wrists. He keeps his other hand on the visible catalogue page, sustaining their ordinary public interaction. Her head turns slightly toward an approaching visitor, a composed welcoming expression maintained while the guest's lowered eyes follow the card. The folded card and joined transfer are visible to the camera from the guest side, while the catalogue screens them from the room behind her. Make a horizontal three-quarter-length cinematic photograph from just below chest height, close enough that her face and the transfer occupy the two dominant areas of the frame. Keep both faces, the catalogue and the card-transfer hands in one readable focal region; let the restored painting, reception guests and controlled doorway remain recognizable behind them. Warm gallery light brushes her cheek and the ivory tailoring, with cooler conservation-room light beyond the rope. Natural skin texture, believable fabric weight and a quiet observational camera position convey the instant when a polished public role and a hidden exchange coexist.
